entries.title: Copy sessions from another event
entries.summary: bring sessions or abstracts from any other event in your organization into the one you're working in: pick the source event, select what to copy (no limit — large selections run in batches), map or create tracks, formats, rooms, tags, and custom fields, and confirm. Copies keep a visible link to their original on both sessions' Connections tabs.

entries.title: Merge tags for every session role
entries.summary: emails sent from the Sessions module can name a session's moderators, chairpersons, and any custom role you've created directly in the message body, each with a "with titles" version that adds job title and company. The tags are grouped under **Session Roles** in the tag picker, alongside the existing speaker tags.

entries.title: Session duration merge tag
entries.summary: a new Session Duration (minutes) tag renders how long a session runs, worked out from its start and end times, so a speaker email can say "your session runs for 45 minutes" without looking it up.

entries.title: Nominee Headshot field for Awards forms
entries.summary: the Awards form builder's Quick Add panel gains a Nominee Headshot field: submitters upload a single JPG, PNG, or GIF, and the image renders as a headshot in review sidebars, PDFs, and exports.

entries.title: Per-portal session ordering
entries.summary: a new **Session list order** setting on each portal's Configuration step controls how sessions and abstracts are ordered on the portal home: **Chronological** (scheduled sessions in agenda order, unscheduled last) or **Alphabetical**.

entries.title: Clearer document template downloads
entries.summary: the template editor's **Options** menu now separates **Download blank template** (the layout with merge fields unresolved) from **Generate for records** (finished documents bound to the records you pick), replacing the single ambiguous Download action.

entries.title: Bulk file download for interest forms
entries.summary: select interest-form submissions and click **Download Files** to get every uploaded file in one zip, organized by submission and named by question; the archive lands in **History → Exports**.

entries.title: AND/OR recipient filters on campaigns
entries.summary: advanced recipient filters on email campaigns can now combine with **Match all** (AND) or **Match any** (OR), so one send can target "Track A or Track B".

entries.title: Copy a site's configuration
entries.summary: the Add Site dialog can start a new site from an existing one, copying settings, branding, and pages while you pick a fresh URL; the Clone Event options gain a matching **Sites** checkbox.

entries.title: Tag colors
entries.summary: session tags can be given a preset or custom color when you create or edit them, and tag chips show it everywhere tags appear.

entries.title: Word and character limits on text questions
entries.summary: **Customize Question** on a text field now has a **Length Limit** section: set a minimum and/or maximum and count in characters or words. Submitters see a live counter, and answers outside the limits are rejected.

entries.title: Multi-page portal forms
entries.summary: split a portal form into pages with **Page Break** blocks: portal users see a step indicator with your page titles, move through the form with Next and Back, and required questions validate per page. A new **Preview** button shows the form exactly as a portal user will see it, without leaving the builder.

entries.title: Conditional logic on display blocks
entries.summary: rich text blocks and section headers on portal forms can now be shown or hidden based on a previous answer, just like questions.

entries.title: "New submission" automation trigger
entries.summary: session automations can now fire when a form submission is completed (any form, or one you pick), and session email actions have a **Send to** choice: all participants, the submitter only, or both. Ideal for an instant "we received your submission" email.

entries.title: Event-name merge tag in forms
entries.summary: use {{event_name}} in submission-form and portal-form content (welcome text, section titles, descriptions, rich text, confirmation message) and it renders as the event's name — so duplicated forms don't carry last year's event name.

entries.title: Copy fields from another event
entries.summary: from **Settings → Library → Fields**, **Add Field → Copy from…** imports custom fields from other events you can access; same-name fields are reused instead of duplicated.

entries.title: Email themes on campaigns
entries.summary: event email campaigns without their own theme are now wrapped in the event's default email theme, and a **Design not compiled** badge flags themes whose latest design edits haven't compiled into the sent HTML yet.
